listings.description: Perched directly above a sandy arc of shoreline, this top-floor condo frames wide ocean views from nearly every room. The open kitchen features quartz counters and a breakfast bar, perfect for easy entertaining. A covered balcony catches the sea breeze, and the complex offers a lap pool and secure parking.

Tucked among tall pines on a quiet ridge, this timber cabin offers a classic mountain retreat. A stone fireplace anchors the great room, and the wraparound deck looks out toward distant peaks. Trails start just beyond the back fence, and the detached garage stores skis and bikes.

Set in the capital's historic Old Parliament Quarter, this light-filled loft blends brick walls with sleek finishes. An airy living area flows to a chef's kitchen with a long island and gas range. Cafes, galleries, and two metro lines are within a five-minute stroll.

On a tree-lined cul-de-sac in Maple Brook Estates, this spacious single-family home balances comfort and convenience. The main level includes a formal dining room, a sunny family room, and an updated kitchen with pantry. The fenced yard features a pergola and play space, and the three-car garage adds storage.

Fronting the calm waters of Cobalt Lake, this contemporary lakehouse is made for long weekends and summer evenings. Walls of glass open to a broad deck with a built-in grill and private dock. Inside, a vaulted living room and a main-floor suite make hosting easy.

In the walkable Circuit Commons district, this modern townhouse pairs smart-home features with warm finishes. The open-plan main floor connects to a small patio for morning coffee. Community greenways, a makers market, and shuttle stops are just around the corner.

Spread across five pastoral acres in Sunwheel Plains, this updated farmhouse delivers space to breathe. A country kitchen with a range hearth sits at the home's center, while generous bedrooms line the upstairs hall. A classic barn and raised gardens invite hobby farming.

Crowning a boutique tower in the Skyline Crown District, this penthouse commands sweeping city and river views. Floor-to-ceiling glass opens to a private roof terrace with an outdoor kitchen and fire table. Residents enjoy concierge service, a fitness studio, and two deeded parking spaces.

Nestled on a lane above the harbor, this shingled cottage captures the charm of Gull Harbor. A cozy living room with a potbelly stove leads to a bright eat-in kitchen. The fenced yard blooms with coastal herbs, and the beach path begins a block away.

Hidden in Mossvale Grove, this eco-home is designed for quiet living among the ferns. Solar arrays, battery backup, and a rainwater system keep utility bills low without sacrificing comfort. Clerestory windows and polished concrete floors create a calm, modern aesthetic.

At Alpenglow Summit, this chalet offers true ski-in access and panoramic alpine vistas. A double-height great room opens to a hot tub deck, perfect after long runs. The lower level includes a bunk room and media lounge for crowd-pleasing weekends.

This efficient studio in Metro Needle puts the skyline at your doorstep. High ceilings, tall windows, and a clever wall bed maximize space and light. Elevator access, bike storage, and rapid transit downstairs make car-free living effortless.

Sheltered by red rock formations in Red Mesa Bluffs, this handcrafted adobe embraces the desert climate. Thick earthen walls temper the heat while vigas and nichos add artisanal character. An inner courtyard with a shade ramada encourages evening gatherings.

On Willowbend Quay, this riverfront bungalow feels like a getaway in the city. French doors open to a deep deck overlooking slow-moving water and willow trees. An updated kitchen and two full baths make everyday life simple and comfortable.

Poised atop Azure Cliffs Reserve, this sprawling villa blends resort amenities with refined finishes. An infinity pool merges with the horizon, while a catering-ready kitchen and wine room support grand entertaining. A private cinema, gym, and six en-suite bedrooms define uncompromising comfort.

Along Lantern Row's cobblestones, this restored brick rowhouse combines period details with modern systems. Original fireplaces and millwork sit beside a sleek kitchen and spa-like baths. A pocket garden with brick seating offers a quiet escape.

In the revitalized Granite Works neighborhood, this well-maintained duplex offers two mirror-image three-bedroom flats. Each unit features hardwood floors, updated kitchens, and separate utilities. Off-street parking and a fenced yard enhance rental appeal.

Tucked in Spruce Hollow, this thoughtfully crafted tiny house embraces minimalist living. A lofted sleeping area, built-in storage, and a compact kitchen make the most of every inch. The covered porch faces a meadow, inviting slow mornings.

Set along a palm-lined lane in Coral Cay Village, this breezy coastal cottage balances indoor comfort with outdoor living. Double sets of French doors open to a screened veranda that catches the trade winds. A short stroll leads to sandy coves and a community dock.

Overlooking working slips at Harbor Innovation Pier, this corner condo showcases floor-to-ceiling glass and harbor views. The kitchen features integrated appliances and a quartz waterfall island. Residents enjoy a rooftop lounge, co-working space, and secure bike room.
